services.name: custom noun
services.summary: your own office noun, drawn from the cc0 nouns traits.
services.give: a name or role, and a trait or two you like.
services.get: one noun drawn for you, as a picture file.

services.name: a series for your project
services.summary: ten pieces, minted free on tezos.
services.give: your project, a short brief, and a tezos address to receive it.
services.get: a ten-piece series on tezos, free to collect.

services.name: rent a noun
services.summary: a hire badge on your page or post for a day.
services.give: the page or post, and the day.
services.get: a noun badge for that day.

services.name: a memo
services.summary: a one-line interoffice memo written about your thing.
services.give: the thing, and a link if there is one.

services.name: a drum piece
services.give: a noun, or a theme, and the sound you want.
services.get: a noun that plays when tapped.

services.name: a desk on the loom
services.summary: your own public thread, tied to your wallet.
services.give: a wallet address and a thread name.
services.get: a public thread on the loom that is yours.
